items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes, for a smooth projective scheme over a base field of characteristic zero with the given data and axioms, when the comparison map from the cohomology of the spectrum of the ring of global sections to the degree zero cohomology is an isomorphism, in terms of injectivity of the pullbacks to finitely many closed points with separable residue fields, and identifies these with the generation of the top cohomology by classes of points when the scheme is equidimensional (statement lines 3859-3874). The proof (proof lines 3875-3926) reduces to the connected case, compares the conditions through the axioms, and uses a finite separable base change to make the points rational. H3: a multi step equivalence with a base change argument, written out in full.
